snippet.title: TAITO Arcade 1 - Evercade Cartridge Tour
snippet.description:
Captured off the Evercade VS. While not technically the first time we saw TAITO arcade games make way to the Evercade family, given the existence of their edition of the HyperMegaTech! Super Pocket, it was about time they would get cartridges to be more accessible for those who want to play on their VS and VS-R.

00:00 - Intro
00:15 - Bubble Bobble
02:36 - Chack'n Pop
06:49 - Colony 7
10:26 - Don Doko Don
16:08 - Growl
21:30 - The Legend of Kage
25:05 - Pirate Pete
27:20 - Raimais
30:20 - Space Invaders
